Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/textStyleRanges.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. blocker (line 162): The undo/redo test fails at line 175, and the test is what's wrong, not the FR-24 history capture. beforeEach seeds the scene with API.setElements, which goes through the h.elements setter: replaceAllElements with no capture, so the store's committed snapshot never contains the text. The range pick's IMMEDIATELY capture therefore records the text as an *added* element whose inserted side already carries the red styleRanges. Keyboard.undo() reverts that entry by setting isDeleted: true. The deleted element keeps its red range, and getText() reads it through scene.getElement, which also returns deleted elements. That is exactly the failure reported (red range still present after undo). The capture code is correct: once the text is committed, the pick's delta is { deleted: { styleRanges: undefined }, inserted: { styleRanges: [...] } }, which undo and redo apply both ways. Confidence: high (worked out from history.ts / delta.ts ElementsDelta.calculate 'added' path and the h.elements setter; not run). — fix: In this test, before editText, commit the text as a baseline: `API.updateScene({ elements: [text], captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY })`, importing CaptureUpdateAction from @excalidraw/element. Also assert `getText(text.id).isDeleted` is false after undo, so the test can't pass or fail on a deleted element. Do not change actionProperties.tsx or textWysiwyg.tsx. Note that this departs from U19 rule 1, which only uses API.setElements.

instruction:
Fix `packages/element/src/textStyleRanges.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. minor (line 330): getStyledLines departs from rule 7. While looking for the next soft-wrapped line, the loop skips any character that is not '\n' (not just whitespace) until startsWith matches. If the wrapped text ever differs from originalText (for example a normalisation mismatch), runs are silently attached to the wrong offsets further along, instead of falling back to one unstyled run at p. — fix: Skip only whitespace characters other than '\n' (e.g. `/\s/.test(ch) && ch !== "\n"`). Let the existing `!matched` branch handle any line that doesn't start there.
2. minor (line 60): DRY: the conditional `...(x.color !== undefined ? { color } : {}), ...(x.highlight !== undefined ? { highlight } : {})` range-building spread appears about 8 times (normalize, merge, the applyTextStyle before/inside/after/gap parts, shift, sanitize). — fix: Add a private `makeRange(start, end, color?, highlight?)` that omits undefined keys, and use it at every site.
